faq.title: Questions, answered.
faq.lead: The essentials before you bring VieroClick into your team's daily work.
faq.freeQuestion: Can my team start for free?
faq.freeAnswer: Yes. The Starter plan costs 0₫ and supports up to five members and three projects, with daily report and morning briefing agents included.
faq.agentsQuestion: What do the six AI agents actually do?
faq.agentsAnswer: They cover planning, assignment, progress observation, daily reporting, morning briefings, and project Q&A. Each agent reads the current project state before it responds.
faq.approvalQuestion: Will AI change project work without approval?
faq.approvalAnswer: You choose the control level per project. Review-required mode holds suggestions for a person to approve, while full-auto mode can apply qualified actions automatically.
faq.teamsQuestion: Can different departments use the same workspace?
faq.teamsAnswer: Yes. Projects, marketing, product and engineering, operations, people, and leadership teams can keep their own workflows while sharing the same workspace and project data.
faq.telegramQuestion: How does the Telegram integration work?
faq.telegramAnswer: Teams can request project status and reports from Telegram. Proposed updates and blocker reports use an approval step before they are committed to the project.
